# Project Overview

This project is a web application that allows users to create and manage songs and setlist for worship music. It is built using React and Node.js, and uses MongoDB for data storage.

## Folder Structure

- `/ui`: Contains the source code for the frontend.
- `/server`: Contains the source code for the Node.js backend, APIs

## Libraries and Frameworks

- React and MaterialUI for the frontend.
- Node.js and Express for the backend.
- MongoDB for data storage.

## UI guidelines

- Application should be dynamic for mobile and desktop view
